name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 53 - Am 5
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 53a. Calls on the Commission to establish a single, publicly accessible database covering all NGO grants, contracts, sub-grants and funded projects, including beneficiaries, amounts and relevant funding programmes; calls for the publication of underlying contracts upon request and the names and affiliations of external experts involved in funding decisions; stresses that, where NGOs receive EU funding, their financial relations and use of EU funds should be subject to full transparency, scrutiny and democratic accountability;
